title: Page 1
lines: 「少主，饶命啊！求你饶了小的一命！」
朱雀城外城东一隅胡同内，传来一道惊恐的求饶声，声音里透着无尽恐惧，显示声音的主人此刻有多惧怕站在他面前、身着月牙白袍的男人。
身着月牙白袍的男人右手执着碧玉箫轻敲左掌，修长挺拔的身形斜倚在石墙上，清俊的脸上含笑，状似闲适地笑望着被打得鼻青脸肿、跪在地上磕头求饶的男人。
「张吉，你跟了我五年，应该知道我是个什么样的主子。疑人不用，用人不疑，一向是我的原则。但若那人背叛我的信任，下场会是如何，你应该十分清楚才对。」对于背叛者，他一向不会心慈手软。
「少主，我错了！我不该一时鬼迷心窍起了贪念，在帐上动手脚，求少主饶了小的一命！」张吉早已磕头磕得头破血流，仍是不敢停下来，只求能保住一命。
「你好大的胆子，竟敢在帐上动手脚，偷了铺子里的十万两，还与外人勾结，偷了三条价值不菲的水晶项链。你监守自盗，还当真以为能逃得过吗？」敢情是小看他了。对于背叛他的人，即便是逃到天涯海角，他也有办法找到，绝不可能轻易放过。
「少主饶命啊！」张吉即使磕头磕得满脸鲜血，仍一再求饶。都怪自己一时起了贪念，才会铸下如此大错。心知今日在劫难逃，只盼能保住一命。
「念你跟了我五年，虽然最后背叛了我，但毕竟主仆一场，我可以饶你一命，就留下你的右手吧。」清俊脸上笑容不变，就连双眼也含笑，吐出的话语却冷血得令人打颤。
张吉一听完，脸色惨白，身子发软，整个趴在地上，动也不动。
「韦翰，将他右手砍下。」
随侍一旁的护卫脸上虽然有丝不忍，但也只能怪张吉自作自受，胆敢背叛少主，辜负少主的信任，只砍下他右臂没取他性命，已算是少主难得的慈悲了。正欲对准他的右臂砍下－－
「住手！」
一道娇叱随着银光一闪，击中长剑，长剑被这突来的力道给击落。
同一时间，一抹水蓝薄纱身影伴随着淡香翩然而至，无惧地挡在张吉面前，一双翦水杏眸直视着斜倚在石墙上的男人。
「你们这是在做什么？怎可动用私刑，你们眼中还有王法吗？」
慕容彻清俊的脸上没有丝毫不悦，脸上依旧含笑，那笑容却多了抹兴味。
没想到出手阻止他的竟是一名模样灵秀柔美出尘的姑娘。
但见她眼若晨星，眉若新月，肤似白玉，是个难得一见的灵秀脱俗美人；难得的是这样一个绝美佳人竟懂武，更大胆地阻挡了他惩戒下人的事，就这一点，该说她是见义勇为呢，还是……愚不可及？
裴璎珞在男人打量她的同时也看清了他的容貌。男人五官清俊，脸上挂着笑，连眉眼间都充满笑意。这男人笑得一脸无害的模样，一点也看不出来方才下令时语气里透着绝情，若非她出手阻止，还真以为自己看错了人。
男人打量完她，挺拔的身形倏地站直，右手执箫轻敲左掌的动作未停，脸上挂着笑，缓步朝一脸防备的她走近。
「姑娘，你是谁？劝你莫多管闲事才好。」
「公子，我无意多管闲事，只不过适才经过胡同口，听到你们的对话。就算他背叛了你，但取人一臂这私刑也未免太过残忍无情了。」
裴璎珞本非好管闲事之人，更何况出门在外，多一事不如少一事，但当她听到他命人砍下一臂时，忍不住就出手了。
「姑娘，敢情你是想当和事老，只可惜这档事不是你管得了的，劝你还是速速离去吧。」
慕容彻见这姑娘孤身一人出现在这里，身旁又无人陪伴，还敢插手管闲事，还真是胆大妄为，难得好心地提醒她。
「公子，你都将人打成半条命了，气也该消了，何不将他送官呢，由官府还你一个公道？」
裴璎珞望着眼前含笑的男人，心底明白得很，尽管此人脸上笑容是那样无害，但绝非好应付之人。
「报官？」
慕容彻脸上的笑容加深了，似是她说了十分可笑的话，眼角余光瞥见一抹趁隙逃脱的身影，黑眸一眯，旋身捡起地上的长剑，手起剑落，眨眼间动作一气呵成，由后砍下张吉右臂－－
一道凄厉的嚎叫声响起，张吉跪倒在地，抱着断臂，嘴里不停地发出惨叫。
裴璎珞完全被这血淋淋的一幕给吓傻了。
柔美的小脸发白，不敢置信杏眸大睁，看着鲜血在她眼前飞溅，还有飞落在她脚旁的断臂。
而那个在转身一瞬间砍下他人一臂、此刻眉眼不眨望着她的男人笑容依旧。
这个男人……太可怕了。
「二小姐……」
秋月行经胡同口，听到有人惨叫，好奇探头一望，不意撞见这血淋淋的一幕，惊骇地准备快速离开，没想到却瞧见二小姐竟然在里头，顾不得害怕，冲进胡同内一把拉着二小姐便跑。
裴璎珞吓傻了，任由秋月拉着她跑离。
慕容彻望着主仆匆忙离去的背影，黑眸中若有所思，眼角余光瞥见一抹光亮，走上前捡起地上一支梅花簪；此簪造形精巧，雕刻的梅花栩栩如生，一看即知非凡品，绝非寻常人买得起的饰物。
将梅花簪收进怀中，大步走出胡同。韦翰尾随在后，对那阵阵凄厉的哭嚎声置若罔闻。
「不要！」
随着惊叫声，下一刻，床榻上的人儿倏地惊醒，杏眸底仍残存着惊骇，小脸上余悸犹存。
「二小姐，你又作恶梦了吗？」
秋月关心地掀开床幔，果然看到二小姐已清醒，脸色惨白，忍不住在心底叹了口气。任何人看到那血淋淋的一幕都很难忘记的。
「秋月，什么时辰了？」裴璎珞转移话题，不想让她担心。
「已是卯时了。二小姐要起床梳洗吗？」
「好。」裴璎珞轻揉额际，连日来受恶梦惊扰，令她精神不济。
秋月掀开锦被，动作俐落地服侍主子穿戴好衣裳，再扶着她坐到梳妆台前，替她梳了个发髻，插上凤尾金步摇，戴上白玉花形耳坠，手戴翠玉珠链。
打扮好的裴璎珞娇而不媚、艳而不俗，柔美细致的五官让她更显得灵秀出尘，秋月十分满意地欣赏着。
三位小姐各有独特的美。二小姐性情温婉恬静，说话时娇软的语调总是不疾不徐，听了令人十分舒服，她向来以伺候二小姐为荣。
「可惜了梅花簪不知被谁捡去。」裴璎珞望着铜镜中的自己，抬手轻触凤尾金步摇，总觉得它太过艳丽，不若梅花簪来得雅致。
「二小姐，别难过了。等回去后，二小姐再绘制图稿，命琢金铺重新打造一支梅花簪就行了，二小姐就别再难过了。」秋月知道二小姐遗失最喜欢的梅花簪，一直念念不舍。
「也只好如此了。」裴璎珞叹了口气。
叩叩！房门外传来叩门声，紧接着传来一道客气的询问声：
「裴姑娘醒了吗？」
「有事吗？」秋月上前
丫鬟朝里头的裴璎珞弯身一福后，这才开口：「裴姑娘，夫人交代，若是你醒了，就一同到偏厅用早膳。」
「好的，我马上就去。」
裴璎珞起身，在秋月的陪同下，跟着丫鬟往偏厅而去。
昨儿个，她们主仆二人抵达玄武城苏府时，代表珠玉阁裴家献上贺礼，替苏老爷贺寿；寿宴结束后，也就留住了下来。

Chapter 1(1)
"Young Master, please spare my life! Please spare my little life!"
In an alley in the east corner of Suzaku City, a frightened voice begging for mercy was heard. There was endless fear in the voice, showing how afraid the owner of the voice was at the moment of the man in a crescent white robe standing in front of him.
The man in a crescent-moon white robe held a jade flute in his right hand and tapped his left palm. His slender and tall figure was leaning against the stone wall, with a smile on his handsome face. He seemed to be smiling leisurely as he looked at the beaten man with a bruised nose and face, who was kneeling on the ground and kowtowed to beg for mercy.
"Zhang Ji, you have been with me for five years, so you should know what kind of master I am. It has always been my principle not to doubt people but not to trust people. But if that person betrays my trust, you should be very clear about what will happen." He has never been merciful to betrayers.
"Young Master, I was wrong! I shouldn't have been obsessed with greed and tampered with the tent, begging Young Master to spare my life!" Zhang Ji had kowtowed until his head was bleeding, but he still didn't dare to stop, just hoping to save his life.
"You are so courageous. You dared to tamper with the account and steal a hundred thousand taels from the shop. You also colluded with outsiders to steal three valuable crystal necklaces. You just kept it to yourself. Do you really think you can escape?" Ganqing underestimated him. For those who betrayed him, even if they fled to the ends of the earth, he would find a way to find them and would never let them go easily.
"Young master, have mercy on me!" Zhang Ji kept begging for mercy even though his face was covered with blood from kowtow.都怪自己一时起了贪念，才会铸下如此大错。 I knew in my heart that I was going to be doomed today, and I could only hope to save my life.
"Nian, you have been with me for five years. Although you betrayed me in the end, after all, we are a master and a servant. I can spare your life and keep your right hand." The smile on Qingjun's face did not change, even his eyes were smiling, but the words he spat out were so cold-blooded that it made people shiver.
As soon as Zhang Ji finished listening, his face turned pale, his body became weak, and he lay on the ground motionless.
"Wickham, cut off his right hand."
"Yes!"
Although there was a trace of reluctance on the faces of the guards who were accompanying him, they could only blame Zhang Ji for having brought it upon himself. He dared to betray the young master and betrayed the young master's trust. He only cut off his right arm without taking his life. This was a rare mercy from the young master. He was about to chop off his right arm——
"Stop!"
A scream followed by a flash of silver light, hitting the long sword, and the long sword was knocked down by the sudden force.
At the same time, a figure in aqua blue gauze accompanied by light fragrance came gracefully and stood in front of Zhang Ji fearlessly. A pair of apricot eyes looked directly at the man leaning against the stone wall.
"What are you doing? How can you use lynching? Do you still have the law in your eyes?"
There was no hint of displeasure on Murong Che's handsome face, and there was still a smile on his face, but that smile had a touch of interest.
没想到出手阻止他的竟是一名模样灵秀柔美出尘的姑娘。
But seeing that her eyes were like morning stars, her eyebrows were like a crescent moon, and her skin was like white jade, she was a rare and graceful beauty. What was rare was that such a beautiful woman knew martial arts and boldly stopped him from punishing his servants. On this point, should I say that she acted bravely for justice, or... was stupid?
Pei Yingluo saw the man's appearance clearly while he was looking at her. The man has handsome features, a smile on his face, and even his eyebrows are full of smiles. The man smiled harmlessly, and there was no hint of the ruthlessness in his tone when he just gave the order. If she hadn't stopped him, she would have thought she had seen the wrong person.
After the man looked at her, he stood upright with his tall figure. He held the flute in his right hand and tapped his left palm without stopping. With a smile on his face, he slowly approached her who looked defensive.
"Girl, who are you? I advise you not to mind your own business."
"Sir, I don't mean to be nosy, but I just passed by the alley and overheard your conversation. Even if he betrayed you, lynching someone by arm would be too cruel and heartless."
Pei Yingluo was not a nosy person, let alone when she was away from home. One more thing was better than one less thing, but when she heard that he ordered someone to cut off an arm, she couldn't help but take action.
"Girl, I bet you want to be a peacemaker, but it's a pity that this matter is beyond your control. I advise you to leave as soon as possible."
Murong Che saw that this girl appeared here alone, with no one by her side, and dared to meddle in other people's affairs. She was really audacious, so it was rare for him to kindly remind her.
"Sir, you've beaten someone to half a life, and it's time to let go of your anger. Why don't you send him to the government so that the government can give you justice?"
Pei Yingluo looked at the smiling man in front of her and knew very well in her heart that although the smile on his face was so harmless, he was by no means an easy person to deal with.
"Reporter?"
The smile on Murong Che's face deepened, as if she had said something very ridiculous. He caught a glimpse of a figure escaping from the corner of his eye. He narrowed his black eyes, turned around and picked up the long sword on the ground, raised the sword and dropped it. In the blink of an eye, he cut off Zhang Ji's right arm from behind -
A shrill howl sounded, and Zhang Ji fell to his knees, hugging his broken arm, and kept screaming from his mouth.
Pei Yingluo was completely frightened by this bloody scene.
Her soft little face turned pale, her apricot eyes widened in disbelief, watching the blood splashing in front of her eyes, and the severed arm flying down next to her feet.
And the man who cut off the other person's arm the moment he turned around and was looking at her without blinking was still smiling.
This man... is terrible.
"Second Miss..."
Qiuyue was walking by the entrance of the alley when she heard someone screaming. She looked out curiously and unexpectedly saw this bloody scene. She was horrified and prepared to leave quickly. Unexpectedly, she saw the second lady inside. Regardless of her fear, she rushed into the alley, grabbed the second lady and ran away.
Pei Yingluo was so frightened that she let Qiuyue pull her away.
Murong Che looked at the hurried away figures of his master and servant, his dark eyes thoughtful, and he caught a glimpse of light from the corner of his eye. He stepped forward and picked up a plum blossom hairpin on the ground. This hairpin was exquisitely shaped, and the carved plum blossoms were lifelike. He knew it was extraordinary at first sight, and it was definitely not an accessory that ordinary people could afford.
He put the plum blossom hairpin into his arms and strode out of the alley. Wickham followed, turning a deaf ear to the shrill cries.
"No!"
Following the scream, the next moment, the person on the bed suddenly woke up, with fear still remaining in his almond-shaped eyes, and the lingering fear on his face.
"Second Miss, are you having nightmares again?"
Qiuyue opened the bed curtain with concern, and saw that the second young lady was awake and pale, and she couldn't help but sigh in her heart. It will be difficult for anyone to forget the bloody scene.
"Qiuyue, what time is it?" Pei Yingluo changed the subject, not wanting to worry her.
"It's already midnight. Second lady, do you want to get up and freshen up?"
"Okay." Pei Yingluo rubbed her forehead gently. She had been disturbed by nightmares for the past few days, which made her mentally weak.
Qiuyue opened the brocade quilt, helped her master put on her clothes with deft movements, then helped her sit in front of the dressing table, combed her hair into a bun, put on a golden phoenix tail, white jade flower-shaped earrings, and a emerald bead necklace.
The well-dressed Pei Yingluo is charming but not charming, gorgeous but not vulgar. Her soft and delicate facial features make her even more beautiful. Qiuyue admires it with great satisfaction.
Each of the three ladies has a unique beauty. The second young lady has a gentle and quiet temperament, and her soft tone when speaking is always slow and slow, which makes people feel very comfortable. She has always been proud to serve the second young lady.
"It's a pity that I don't know who picked up the plum blossom hairpin." Pei Yingluo looked at herself in the bronze mirror, raised her hand and touched the golden phoenix tail. She always felt that it was too gorgeous and not as elegant as the plum blossom hairpin.
"Second Miss, don't be sad. After you go back, Second Miss will draw the drawings and order the gold shop to make a new plum blossom hairpin. Second Miss, don't be sad anymore." Qiuyue knew that Second Miss had lost her favorite plum blossom hairpin, and she kept thinking about it.
"That's all we have to do." Pei Yingluo sighed.
Knock knock! There was a knock on the door, followed by a polite inquiry:
"Is Miss Pei awake?"
"Is something wrong?" Qiuyue stepped forward
The maid bent towards Pei Yingluo inside, and then said, "Miss Pei, Madam, if you wake up, we will go to the side hall to have breakfast together."
"Okay, I'll go right away."
Pei Yingluo stood up and, accompanied by Qiuyue, followed the maid to the side hall.
Yesterday, when their master and servant arrived at the Su Mansion in Xuanwu City, they presented congratulatory gifts on behalf of the Pei family of Zhuyu Pavilion to congratulate Mr. Su on his birthday. After the birthday banquet, they stayed.
